programme.title: Wild Waters
programme.desc: From the highest mountain to the lowest valley, rivers and streams are freshwater highways, de-livering essential life blood to all kinds of wildlife. From some of the most iconic species like the otter and the trout, to the unfamiliar and elusive, like the delicate harvest mouse. Life on these freshwater freeways can be tough, and for many it's a constant battle just to stay alive. Take a break from the oceans and turn to the rivers and streams, home to the real wild waters of the nat-ural world.

programme.title: Nature's Most Dangerous
programme.desc: Who's not a thrill seeker among us? We humans love to put ourselves at risk and lap up the thrill of living dangerously. And to fuel our fetish for fear, we turn to the animal kingdom. But what is the truth behind the killers of the natural world? Do they live up to their reputations, and who really is the most dangerous? From killer crocs to ferocious big cats, we'll run you through the most dangerous teeth, fangs, stingers and bites in the animal kingdom. These are the deadliest animals on planet earth.

programme.title: Hunters of the Forest
programme.desc: Forests are dark, shady habitats, realms of shadows perfect for predators to lurk. The dense plant growth facilitates a wealth of prey species, and cunning predators of all shapes and sizes have adapted to exploit every niche. Whether crawling on the forest floor, gliding through the trees or stalking the shadows in between, hunters have mastered the terrain in every type of forest imagina-ble. And they're not just stealthy, they're also some of the most enigmatic and beautiful creatures on the planet.

programme.title: Meet The Marsupials
programme.desc: Few countries have a more iconic representative in the animal kingdom than Australia and the marsupial. Marsupials were once found across the planet, but over time they found their way to the outback, leaving Australia as an ark carrying the future of pouch mammals. As varied as they are unusual, marsupials are a weird and wonderful mob of animals who carry their young in a pouch. Whether hopping, climbing or even airborne, marsupials are some of the strangest but most fascinating creatures you're likely to meet.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth Journey To The Land
programme.desc: As the first landmasses emerged from prehistoric seas, animals took their first steps on dry land. The explosion of life that followed changed the world forever.

programme.title: Epic Safari Encounters: Mana Pools
programme.desc: Kristina travels to the Mana Pools National Park with guide Craig van Zyl. They come across mating lions, have close encounters with bull elephants and canoe just meters away from imposing hippos and crocodiles on the mighty Zambezi River.

programme.title: Extinction! Going, Going, Gone
programme.desc: Extinction, a daunting and confusing word. A force of nature, that sees the end of species, but also heralds the birth of others. Right now the extinction rate could be as much as 10,000 times faster than it should be. 20% of fish, a fifth of all reptiles and a quarter of mammals face extinction. If we are to do anything to stem the tide of extinction we must understand the lifestyles of those in danger. The future for countless animals is uncertain, but one thing is for sure – we have a lot to learn.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: As the tide rises in New Zealand's Northland Harbours, Stingrays and Eagle rays swim in to feast on shellfish. But they are not the top of the food chain. Only in New Zealand, and only in these harbours do Orca hunt rays. Trapped in the shallows, the rays breach the surface and swim for their lives, as the Orca pursue – with a highly evolved practice for avoiding the rays' stinging tail. As the tide ebbs, the once underwater world of Northland's mangroves surfaces and seethes. Twisted roots that moments ago sheltered fish are now exposed - a seafood platter for patient Herons, Spoonbills, and Shags.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.desc: Pavel Hubeny, whose life would be unthinkable without the forest, is the head of the Šumava National Park. He is committed to ensuring that a primeval forest can grow for future generations, in which man does not interfere. This vision of a primeval forest is also shared by the forester Claus Bässler, who wants to counteract the extinction of species by having trees felled to create artificial deadwood and thus a new habitat for rare beetles and fungi. On the Vltava River lies the small town of Krumlov, the "Pearl of the Bohemian Forest" with its Baroque theater and fully preserved stage technology from the 17th century. Here the director Zuzana Vrbová enchants people from all over the world with her productions. Apart from agriculture, it was mainly the abundance of forests that ensured the livelihood of the inhabitants of the Bohemian Forest - including that of the carpenter Philipp von Manz, who processed local wood for his customers all over Germany. Veterinarian Judith Gollner, who grew up in the Austrian part of the Bohemian Forest, lived in Vienna for a long time and made a conscious decision to return. She likes the people and is proud of "her farmers' wives" who share her love of the Bohemian Forest.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Gates of the Arctic National Park and Preserve is an American national park that protects portions of the Brooks Range in northern Alaska. The park is the northernmost national park in the United States, situated entirely north of the Arctic Circle. The park is the second largest in the US, slightly larger in area than Belgium. Gates of the Arctic was initially designated as a national monument on December 1, 1978, before being redesignated as a national park and preserve upon passage of the Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act in 1980. A large part of the park has additional protection as the Gates of the Arctic Wilderness that adjoins the Noatak Wilderness. They form the largest contiguous wilderness in the United States together. Fauna include brown bears, black bears, muskoxen, moose, Dall sheep, timber wolves, wolverines, coyotes, lynxes, marmots, porcupines, river otters, red and Arctic fox species, beavers, snowshoe hares, muskrats, bald eagles, golden eagles, peregrine falcons, ospreys, great horned and northern hawk-owls. More than half a million caribou, including the Central Arctic, Western Arctic, Teshekpuk, and Porcupine herds, migrate through the central Brooks Range twice yearly, traveling north in summer, and south in winter. Caribou are important as a food source to native peoples. The park is the northernmost range limit for the Dall sheep. About 132 brown bears reside in the park and preserve, based on a density of about one bear per 100 square miles.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: The Grand Canyon is a steep-sided canyon carved by the Colorado River in Arizona, United States. The Grand Canyon is 277 miles (446 km) long, up to 18 miles (29 km) wide and attains a depth of over a mile (6,093 feet or 1,857 meters). The canyon and adjacent rim are contained within Grand Canyon National Park, the Kaibab National Forest, Grand Canyon–Parashant National Monument, the Hualapai Indian Reservation, the Havasupai Indian Reservation and the Navajo Nation. President Theodore Roosevelt was a major proponent of preservation of the Grand Canyon area and visited it on numerous occasions to hunt and enjoy the scenery.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Saguaro National Park is an American national park in Pima County, southeastern Arizona. The 92,000-acre (37,000 ha) park consists of two separate areas—the Tucson Mountain District (TMD) about 10 miles west of the city of Tucson and the Rincon Mountain District (RMD) about 10 miles east of the city—that preserve Sonoran Desert landscapes, fauna, and flora, including the giant saguaro cactus.An inventory of medium and large mammals in the park confirmed the presence of 30 species in Saguaro National Park between 1999 and 2008. Of these, 21 were found in the Tucson Mountain District and 29 in the Rincon Mountain District. A partial list of the park's mammals includes cougars, coyotes, bobcats, white-tailed deer, mule deer, javelinas, gray foxes, black-tailed jackrabbits, desert cottontails, ring-tailed cats, white-nosed coatis, ground squirrels, and packrats. One endangered mammal, the lesser long-nosed bat, lives part of the year in the park and part of the year in Mexico.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.sub-title: Curacao, Blue Wonder of the Caribbean
programme.desc: Curacao is one of the most popular attractions for countless cruise ships on their trips through the Caribbean, because it is located outside of the hurricane belt. This is why Eric Miguel is constantly in action. He is the bridge keeper of the Queen Emma Bridge, the landmark of Curacao's capital, Willemstad. After his shift, Eric goes to Yvonne Troeman's cook-shop. Her speciality is Kadushi, a cactus soup. The ingredients include cactus flesh, pigtail's, mussels and a few secret "treats". Barbara van Bebber is the only submarine pilot on Curacao and literally gets to the bottom of things amidst the turquoise-blue wonder of the Caribbean. She charters out her sub to marine biologists and wealthy private explorers, simultaneously cleaning up on the seabed. Her "Curasub" has claw arms, which she employs to remove anything that doesn't belong down there: beer bottles, car tyres, and plastic refuse. Jeroen Eikelenboom simply carts sand from a neighbouring cove to his own surf club in his favourite bay.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: The Wismar Bay is unique in its diversity on the Mecklenburg Baltic Sea coast: cliffs, sandy beaches, salt marshes, enchanted islands and, last but not least, the proud Hanseatic city of Wismar with its brick Gothic buildings, which are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. When the mighty logs get wedged together in the timber mill in the port of Wismar, Steven Buchholz has to get to work with his chainsaw. It's a dangerous job, because the logs weigh tons. As a trained carpenter, Steven is a virtuoso with the chain saw. programme.title: Kingdom Of Heroes
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form. Can the NEXO-Knights and Merlok 2.0 stop the greatest threat they've ever faced? Or will the kingdom be plunged into darkness…forever. The Redoubt of Ruination readies the final ceremony to call forth MONSTRUX, the arch-necromancer of the past. Clay, holding the Book of Betrayal walks to the gates of the spooky place. Inside, Clay hears strange…singing and music. It's like a twisted Broadway show of some kind. Meanwhile, the Knights all realize Clay is gone and so is the Book of Betrayal. Macy says Clay must be up to something. They have to trust him and, more importantly, they have to find him. At the Redoubt of Ruination the ceremony has already begun! The Book of Monsters wants the final ceremony that calls forth Monstrux to be like a really great show! The BOM then barfs up all the BOOKS OF EVIL into their places around Jestro. He's just missing the BOOK OF BETRAYAL, which Clay has. Clay says he'll trade the book for Jestro. The BOM immediately agrees to the deal and sets Jestro free. Then, Monsters grab-up Clay, restrain him, and put him in Jestro's place on the sacrifice stone. From outside, they're interrupted by the sounds of battle the Knights have arrived on the Fortrex and are attacking the Redoubt of Ruination. In the confusion, Jestro slips away. The BOM lets loose with a powerful protection spell to keep the Knights out as he starts with the ceremony…he's going to bring Monstrux out and remanifest him in Clay's body! Jestro is able to escape the Redoubt and make his way to the Knights, who can't seem to battle their way in. It's a race against time as the Knights try to get in and save Clay. As the Knights get in, they see that the crazy BOM is absorbing all the Books of Evil, one-by-one. He grows BIGGER and BIGGER! Macy calls for NEXO-Power…but it's not enough! The gigantic Book of Monsters sucks down the final book, the Book of Betrayal! He looms over Clay, about to consume him, too, and make him into Monstrux! Suddenly, Robin appears carrying TECHKALIBER…he tosses it to Clay. Just as the huge Book of Monsters falls on Clay, he holds up Techkaliber and Merlok 2.0 is there…his full power in the sword. Clay sticks the sword into the Book of Monster's huge mouth. BOOM! There's a BIG, MAGICAL EXPLOSION! As we cut back inside, we see the Book of Monsters is gone. The Knights release Clay and he thanks them and Jestro for saving him. Jestro thanks them all for saving him and seeing the good in him. WE DISSOLVE TO: The JoustDome. In a final ceremony the King and Queen reward the knights and congratulate them for keeping the kingdom safe. There are speeches, happiness and friendship. And Jestro even does a bit that's funny. At the very end we see a hint of something…Monstrux and the Book of Monsters are still out there.

He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Only One Can Remain
programme.desc: On the island, Lloyd learns that his father used to train under the deceitful Master Chen and when the Ninja meet the playfully deceitful ruler, they realize they are in a tournament where “Only one can remain.” On the island, Lloyd learns his father used to train under the deceitful Master Chen. They meet the playfully deceitful ruler who tells them they are in a tournament where ‘Only one can remain'. When they are spoiled by their posh quarters, they are surprised to find the game is already afoot: Last person to find a Jade Blade is out. After an epic battle of elemental powers, Kai steals the last one from Karlof, who is kicked out of the tournament through a trap door leading to the unknown. Later that night, the Ninja go in search for Zane but come across an underground temple where Chen and his Anacondrai Worshippers steal Karlof's power. Is this a fighting tournament, or a ploy to steal everyone's power?

programme.title: Versus
programme.desc: In order find Zane, the Ninja stay in the tournament to get past the first round but Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole. In order to find Zane and get to the bottom of Chen's mysterious plot the Ninja need to stay in the tournament and get past the first round. Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole. Meanwhile, new Titanium Ninja Zane is locked in a dungeon and has a nightmare about a ferocious Ice Dragon. Guided by the voice of Pixal, he embraces his new technology and escapes his cell, only to find Pixal hasn't fared as well. Though she has no body, he inputs her CPU into his, uniting the two. In an attempt to prevent Jay versus Cole, the Ninja enlist the Master of Mind to help, but are unable to prevent the inevitable. In a gladiator battle, Jay and Cole put aside their feud to throw the match --enraging Chen to send Cole down the mysterious trap door. Lastly, Nya sees Zane's beacon is working again and is on the hunt for them.

programme.title: Winds Of Change
programme.desc: Kai promises to watch over Lloyd when Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain– but when Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission... only to discover it's a trap from a GHOST who's escaped the Cursed Realm. After the Ninja save a small fishing village, Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain but Kai promises to watch over him. When Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission... only it's a trap from a GHOST who's escaped the Cursed Realm. When the Ninja's powers mysteriously disappear, they return to the Tea Farm and are attacked by Lloyd, who is possessed by the spirit of Moro, the Master of Wind! After a harrowing escape on the Bounty, Wu tells the Ninja they weren't his first pupils!

programme.title: Ghost Story
programme.desc: When Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja – and the Ninja discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, leaving them to crash. When the dust settles, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja. They discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. In order to save Lloyd and get their powers back, they set off to find the first clue – the scroll to the lost martial art of ‘Airjitzu'. On their way to get it, they have a run in with one of Moro's ghost generals Wraythe, and discover water is the key to stopping them. Meanwhile, Nya discovers a family secret – her mother was a Water Ninja and with training, she could be one too.

programme.title: Saturday Knight Fever
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters catching a cold means trouble for the NEXO-Knights when he can create an entirely new kind of “snotty” monster. King and Queen Halbert have journeyed to the town of Cleanington to open the brand new Scrubbery Barn at the invitation of Roger the Scrubber (seen in 104.) Meanwhile, the Book of Monsters drags Jestro to Snottingham – one of the coldest places in Knighton where everyone coughs, has a runny nose and is generally under-the-weather. The BOM demands that Jestro feed him a “snotheiser” ball which will probably make him sick. The BOM explains that if he is sick, he may just produce a whole new breed of magical monsters … some that the knights would NEVER expect. The BOM gets sick and starts coughing up phlegm globlins and bloblins. The Knights arrive, alerted to what they think is an attack on the town by Snottingham's mayor, Hack Coughmeier. The sickened, sneezy, snotty monsters infect the knights and, more importantly, the knights' NEXO-Shields. Now their NEXO-Powers are infected. As they try to download something to fight the monsters, they realize the powers they get are off strange, infected versions of their powers. The knights drive Jestro and his snot monsters off and they turn in for the night. And, overnight, they all get sick. Meanwhile, the BOM order a nice, hot lava bath…he'll feel fine by morning. But the knights wake-up with colds and they feel terrible. Ava and Merlok 2.0 thinks it will pass in a day or two…it's just a typical Snottingham cold. Each knight gets sick in their own funny way and their illnesses play right into Jestro and the BOM's hands: they're headed to Cleanington to kidnap the king! The citizens of the ultra-clean city hate the sight of monsters, but then feel caught in between when the sick, sneezy, snotty knights arrive on their Fortrex. The fight goes terribly for the knights. They try to download the Nexo-power “Glorious Griffon” but instead get just feathers. So they improvise and tickle the monsters! Ava finally comes up with a way to use some anti-virus tools on their NEXO-Shields and just as Jestro is about to take the king and queen away, the NEXO-Knights get their normal powers back! They defeat Jestro and save the king and queen.

programme.title: Open Mike Knight
programme.desc: The Book of Betrayal leads Jestro and his Monsters to Funnyton – the funnies town in the kingdom. When they Knights arrive to capture him, they discover (to their shock) that Jestro and the Book of Monsters are now the town's top comedians! Jestro and his monsters are in attack formation moving to pillage the town of Funnyton. But when they arrive, ready to tear into the place, they see that nobody's in town. Then, they hear…laughter?! The entire town is there listening to a stand-up comic JOKES KNIGHTLY. He's hilarious. He commands such power, such attention, and such loyalty. Jestro and the BOM decide they must become funny. They order all kinds of book on comedy from Spamazon: books on parody, irony, insult humor, slapstick, satire, knock-knock jokes, elephant jokes, “my monster is so fat” jokes, etc. They work-up a ventriloquist act with the BOM sitting on Jestro's lap. They start doing their act and, surprisingly, they're funny. They're very funny. The Fortrex arrives and the knights rush out, ready for battle. They fight through a string of monsters just outside the town, but discover they're only working as “bouncers” to keep too many people out of the comedy club. (“Sorry, you guys aren't on the list.”) The knights hear loud laughs and head there. In the club, they discover the town isn't being held hostage, they're in the show voluntarily having a great time. And…Jestro and the BOM are funny. Meanwhile, during the show, Jokes Knightly decides he'll steal the BOM and Jestro's act. During the intermission at the comedy show, Clay comes backstage to talk to Jestro. Maybe, Clay says, this shows that Jestro doesn't have to be bad…he is funny, like Clay always said he was. Meanwhile, Jokes Knightly steals the BOM and Jestro can't find it. He panics. Clay encourages him…go on stage alone, be funny…he can do it! Jestro goes out and is funny on his own he hits all his punchlines, he gets big laughs he starts to see that Clay is right. The BOM sees that Jokes Knightly has a “joke book” that turns out to be the BOOK OF BETRAYAL. That's how Mike Knight has become so funny – by stealing everyone's material! BOM calls in Magmar, who saves him from Mike Knight AND takes the Book of Betrayal. As Jestro comes off-stage to great applause, the BOM tells him they have the Book of Betrayal. The BOM calls in Magmar and his monsters and they start a fight as Clay comes to Jestro's defense and calls on the other Knights for backup. A big battle ensues that destroys the comedy club in Funnyton. The Knights win and drive-off Magmar, the monsters and the BOM. As they retreat, the BOM looks around: “Where's my Jestro?!” Jestro sneaked away during the fight and is in a nearby forest with…the Book of Betrayal.

programme.title: The Fortrex And The Furious
programme.desc: In a massive chase around Knighton, the NEXO-Knights attempt to keep the Book of Betrayal out of the Book of Monster's grip. But the evil book is persistent. Will he get the final piece of his evil puzzle? We finally REVEAL that Jestro has given the Book of Betrayal to…Clay. He tells Clay what it is and how Mike Knight used it. And it seems that the Book of Monsters believed it to be the final ingredient in some ‘Master Plan.” Suddenly, they realize Monsters – led by Magmar and the super-mad Book of Monster – are after them! Clay retreats with Jestro and the Book of Betrayal to rendezvous with the other Knights at the Fortrex. The Fortrex isn't fast enough they'll need their own vehicles. They decide that they need to split up and go in multiple directions to make the monsters expend their resources on a chase. It's a huge chase, being covered like a crazy news event by the Knighton News Network. We see a montage of the monsters stopping and capturing all the Knights vehicles: Aaron, Macy, Lance…finally Axl. However, as they do, they realize that the Knights have used Squirebots in Jestro Fan Jester hats (from the vendor at the comedy club in 108) as decoys. They think Axl has the Book of Betrayal in his BRICK containment unit, but it turns out to be the Ned Knightly Comic from episode 203. The Monsters finally corner Clay, who has the real Jestro and Book of Betrayal in his sword vehicle. Before Clay can protest, Jestro pushes the launch button and fires off Clay in the vehicle's rocket sword. The monsters race off with Jestro, leaving the shocked Clay fearing for his friend. Now, Magmar tells the Book of Monsters, they only need to get BOB. Clay makes his way back to the Fortrex and tells what has happened. They decide they must get to the Redoubt of Ruination in the Lava Lands and try to save Jestro. Meanwhile, we see, INTERCUT, a scene where Merlok 2.0 and the Book of Monsters explain the Books of Evil, how they were created and what the BOM will use them for. Merlok, back in the day, split the evil MONSTRUX into 10 magic books to keep him from ever being a threat. Only, he didn't destroy the books…and now the BOM has them and Monstrux can come back into the world! Meanwhile, the BOM has set up the huge, ceremonial arena at their HQ so they can have the ceremony to bring Monstrux back into the world. Jestro realizes he's been a pawn of the Book of Monsters. Jestro says he'll never get the Book of Betrayal…the Knights have it. In the last scene, we see Clay taking the Book of Betrayal from the Fortrex, climbing into his vehicle and driving towards…the Redoubt of Ruination! Has the Book of Betrayal worked its evil magic on him?!

programme.title: Kingdom Of Heroes
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form. Can the NEXO-Knights and Merlok 2.0 stop the greatest threat they've ever faced? Or will the kingdom be plunged into darkness…forever. The Redoubt of Ruination readies the final ceremony to call forth MONSTRUX, the arch-necromancer of the past. Clay, holding the Book of Betrayal walks to the gates of the spooky place. Inside, Clay hears strange…singing and music. It's like a twisted Broadway show of some kind. Meanwhile, the Knights all realize Clay is gone and so is the Book of Betrayal. Macy says Clay must be up to something. They have to trust him and, more importantly, they have to find him. At the Redoubt of Ruination the ceremony has already begun! The Book of Monsters wants the final ceremony that calls forth Monstrux to be like a really great show! The BOM then barfs up all the BOOKS OF EVIL into their places around Jestro. He's just missing the BOOK OF BETRAYAL, which Clay has. Clay says he'll trade the book for Jestro. The BOM immediately agrees to the deal and sets Jestro free. Then, Monsters grab-up Clay, restrain him, and put him in Jestro's place on the sacrifice stone. From outside, they're interrupted by the sounds of battle the Knights have arrived on the Fortrex and are attacking the Redoubt of Ruination. In the confusion, Jestro slips away. The BOM lets loose with a powerful protection spell to keep the Knights out as he starts with the ceremony…he's going to bring Monstrux out and remanifest him in Clay's body! Jestro is able to escape the Redoubt and make his way to the Knights, who can't seem to battle their way in. It's a race against time as the Knights try to get in and save Clay. As the Knights get in, they see that the crazy BOM is absorbing all the Books of Evil, one-by-one. He grows BIGGER and BIGGER! Macy calls for NEXO-Power…but it's not enough! The gigantic Book of Monsters sucks down the final book, the Book of Betrayal! He looms over Clay, about to consume him, too, and make him into Monstrux! Suddenly, Robin appears carrying TECHKALIBER…he tosses it to Clay. Just as the huge Book of Monsters falls on Clay, he holds up Techkaliber and Merlok 2.0 is there…his full power in the sword. Clay sticks the sword into the Book of Monster's huge mouth. BOOM! There's a BIG, MAGICAL EXPLOSION! As we cut back inside, we see the Book of Monsters is gone. The Knights release Clay and he thanks them and Jestro for saving him. Jestro thanks them all for saving him and seeing the good in him. WE DISSOLVE TO: The JoustDome. In a final ceremony the King and Queen reward the knights and congratulate them for keeping the kingdom safe. There are speeches, happiness and friendship. And Jestro even does a bit that's funny. At the very end we see a hint of something…Monstrux and the Book of Monsters are still out there.

The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: Sinister Saga Of A Sick Tummy And A Girl Who Was Afraid Of Doctors
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. Oh yeah!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales

The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Kim Jae-hyung! Kim Jae-hyung is a self-taught guitarist who picked up the guitar when he was serving in the NAVY as a secretary for the naval military band. He continued playing the instrument after his discharge and had the first public performance in 2013 at an unplugged open mic night. Then in 2017 he released his first EP CIRCUS. Three years later he presented his first full-length album Flex which was nominated for Best Folk Album at the 2021 Korean Music Awards and the lead single Failure Story was nominated for Best Folk Song. Kim Jae-hyung is also known for covering a wide spectrum of music. Recently he came up with a new single titled Addiction with danceable vibes. Constantly pushing his musical boundaries this artist definitely makes us look forward to his future moves. In this episode Kim Jae-hyung performs Addiction Failure Story More Doubt and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a singer who just wants to present good music - J_ust! J_ust made his debut in 2015 with the mini-album #DearMuse #201507_08 #PinkRibbon. Known for his heartfelt lyrics and sounds he comforts numerous listeners at the end of a tough day. Thanks to that magical power Jeong Eun-ji from Apink released a remake of his song How's your night for the soundtrack of She's My Type and his song Way Back Home was featured in the ending of JTBC Newsroom. In this episode J_ust performs How's your night Way Back Home I wanna go out Actually I like you and will be happy to console everyone's heart. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy all the heartwarming songs he has to comfort you!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is electronic musician and producer YESEO! This artist burst into the music scene in 2016 with her first single Let It All Go. Two years later in 2018 she was nominated for Best Rookie Best Dance & Electronic Album Best Dance & Electronic Song at the 15th Korean Music Awards with her first EP Million Things. This talented musician mesmerized not only domestic listeners but those outside Korea. The UK's Noisey highlighted YESEO as one of the most ambitious young guns in Seoul and she even opened for Cherokee and Honne during their concerts in Seoul. In this episode YESEO performs Privacy HOT HAND Cigarette Light as well as Youthful Kids and Free Up from her latest EP TRY TREE! Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter YEGNY formerly known as Choi Ye-geun! This artist first became known in 2012 as the genius keyboardist in an audition program titled K-pop Star - Season 2. Since then she has actively pursued her career as a musician releasing a number of singles and working with other top-notch musicians including AKMU. Last year YEGNY released her first full-length album Even If Get Lost It Can Flow Anyway and shared with the public her concerns as a musician and self-reflection as well as her view on human relationships and social issues. With the song Better Rush (feat. Huckleberry P) she changed her stage name to YEGNY to mark a new beginning as an artist. In this episode YEGNY performs Better Rush I know Lucid dream and Unbalance as well as her cover of Better by BoA and Irony by Wonder Girls. Tune in to I'm LIVE and check out all that YEGNY has to show off!

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

La soluzione suggerita dai genitori è: se Pasquale rapisse Angela, la ragazza sarebbe compromessa e s`imporrebbe il classico matrimonio riparatore, al quale non si addice nesusna fastosa cerimonia...

programme.title: I fuorilegge del matrimonio
programme.desc: Sei storie di matrimoni impossibili: tra leggi, ricatti e assurdità burocratiche, uomini e donne si ritrovano intrappolati in legami che non possono sciogliere. Tra manicomio, carcere, divorzio estero e conventi, l'amore si scontra con l'inflessibilità delle istituzioni, generando drammi, equivoci e amara ironia.

programme.title: Cronaca di un amore
programme.desc: Enrico, vittima di una immotivata gelosia nei confronti del passato sentimentale della moglie Paola, assolda un investigatore per capire se gli fedele. Questo atteggiamento spinge Paola tra le braccia di Guido, uomo di cui era innamorata in passato. Inevitabilmente, tra i due scoppia una pericolosa e travolgente passione...

programme.title: 7 Km Da Gerusalemme
programme.desc: Alessandro, un pubblicitario in crisi, si ritrova a Gerusalemme dove incontra un uomo che sostiene di essere Gesù. Scettico, decide comunque di dialogare con lui.

programme.title: Age Out
programme.desc: Appena fuori dal centro adozioni, il diciottenne Richie Wincott va incontro ai pericoli e alle tentazioni della vita. Diventando il primo sospettato per una rapina non riuscita, scopre l'amore ma, con la polizia alle calcagna e qualcuno di sinistro che minaccia di rivelare il suo passato, potrebbe non avere molto tempo per fare la cosa giusta.

programme.title: End of Sentence
programme.desc: Dopo essere rimasto vedovo, Frank Fogle intraprende a malincuore un viaggio per onorare l'ultimo desiderio della moglie di spargere le sue ceneri in un lago remoto della natia Irlanda, promettendo di portare con sé il figlio Sean, da lui allontanato. Quando Sean esce di prigione, l'ultima cosa che ha in mente è un viaggio all'estero con il padre alienato. Quello di cui ha bisogno è un nuovo inizio in California. Ma quando i suoi piani di viaggio vanno a monte, accetta con riluttanza la proposta del padre in cambio di un biglietto per la West Coast e della promessa di non rivedersi mai più. Tra una sconcertante veglia irlandese, il riaffiorare di una vecchia fiamma, il rimorchio di una bella autostoppista e un sacco di questioni irrisolte, il viaggio diventa un po' più di quanto padre e figlio avessero previsto.

programme.title: Remember
programme.desc: Remember racconta la storia di Zev (Christopher Plummer), che scopre che la guardia nazista responsabile della morte della sua famiglia vive in America sotto falso nome. Nonostante le difficoltà, Zev decide di farsi giustizia da solo, intraprendendo un viaggio intercontinentale con conseguenze inaspettate.

programme.title: Mongol
programme.desc: L'infanzia e l'adolescenza del giovane Temudzhin, passato alla storia come Gengis Khan. La leggenda della moglie bambina, quella della rivalità con il migliore amico, la nascita dell'Orda che mise a ferro fuoco l'Asia all'inizio del XIII secolo e altri episodi di rilievo della vita del condottiero compongono un affresco shakespeariano sul senso del potere, il sogno della libertà, la volontà di conquista.

programme.title: UN CASANOVA A NATALE
programme.desc: Elise è una podcaster alla ricerca di contenuti natalizi accattivanti. Elise accetta di aiutare Daniyal e di fargli da guida. Mentre i due si affannano per organizzare il Natale più bello di sempre, diventa chiaro che Daniyal potrebbe stare cercando di conquistare la donna sbagliata.

programme.title: L'EREDITIERA DEL NATALE
programme.desc: Loryn, erede di un grande magazzino negli Hamptons, viene messa alla prova dalla nonna nel tentativo di motivarla. Loryn si destreggia tra le attività lavorative nel negozio durante il periodo più intenso dell'anno: il Natale.

programme.title: IO E MR. CHRISTMAS
programme.desc: Zoe Deans, esperta di pubbliche relazioni, lascia la grande agenzia per aprire la propria attività, ma ha bisogno di un cliente importante per farsi notare. Su suggerimento del suo migliore amico Nic, decide di rappresentare un concorrente al concorso natalizio Mr. Christmas, trasformando l'evento in una grande occasione pubblicitaria. Convinta che creare una piccola celebrità natalizia sia facile grazie alla sua esperienza, Zoe si lancia con entusiasmo in questa sfida non convenzionale — decisa a trovare “il ragazzo giusto” da trasformare in star.

programme.title: UN REGALO SPECIALE
programme.desc: Quando le sorelle Cara e Amy stringono un patto per trovare l'anima gemella entro il prossimo Natale, non si aspettano di essere così fortunate. Un anno dopo, il matrimonio di Amy si avvicina e Cara trova la sua anima gemella, ma la perde rapidamente. Il suo desiderio si avvererà?

programme.title: NATALE A WASHINGTON
programme.desc: Emily è una decoratrice e finalmente riceve l'incarico della vita: deve decorare l'ambasciata più importante della città per Natale. Il lavoro, però, le fa conoscere Magnus Anderson, il nuovo ambasciatore: la magia del Natale scongelerà il suo cuore?

programme.title: Another Happy Day
programme.desc: Alla vigilia del matrimonio di suo figlio, Lynn, una donna che ha sempre nascosto le sue emozioni, insieme ai suoi tre figli dovrà fare i conti con le montagne russe emotive di una riunione di famiglia. Una commedia oscura con Ellen Barkin e Demi Moore.

programme.title: La banda degli onesti
programme.desc: Tre uomini perbene ma goffi che affrontano difficoltà economiche iniziano con riluttanza a fabbricare banconote false. Il figlio di uno di loro è il poliziotto che segue il caso, ignorando il coinvolgimento del padre.

programme.title: Stressati
programme.desc: Marco e Dado sono amici dai tempi del liceo e lavorano nella redazione di un giornale satirico. Dado ha successo con le donne mentre Marco ha molti problemi, fin quando non arrivano Adele e Maria a cambiare le loro vite.

programme.title: Crimen Perfecto
programme.desc: Rafael ama vestirsi bene e si accompagna solo con belle donne. Di sposarsi non ne vuol sapere e si gode il successo come venditore in un grande magazzino. Quando uccide involontariamente un collega, subisce il ricattato di una misteriosa commessa.

programme.title: Otto secondi di gloria
programme.desc: Pellicola biografica sulla vita di Lane Frost, celebre campione del rodeo. Dalla gioventù, quando Lane, grazie agli insegnamenti del padre, inizia a frequentare le gare, fino a diventare il migliore del mondo.

programme.title: Sharon Tate
programme.desc: Incinta del regista Roman Polanski e in attesa del suo ritorno dall'Europa, l'attrice Sharon Tate è perseguitata dalla visione di una sua imminente morte.

programme.title: Arma Micidiale
programme.desc: Angel viene scarcerato e si riunisce con il suo amico Rich che lo aiuta a contrabbandare armi, ma non si rendono conto che la polizia di Detroit e l'FBI stanno lavorando per sgominare il contrabbando.

programme.title: Capone
programme.desc: Gli ultimi anni del noto malvivente Al Capone, quando, a soli 47 anni, dopo dieci anni trascorsi in prigione, comincia a soffrire di demenza e alterna la follia al senso di colpa per i crimini commessi.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Fong è un ladro che ha il vizio del gioco. L'occasione per fare un po' di soldi si presenta quando un magnate gli offre l'incarico di rapire un bambino. L'uomo accetta, ma l'unico problema è che deve prendersi cura del piccolo per qualche giorno.

programme.title: Hansel e Gretel e La Strega Della Foresta Nera
programme.desc: I fratelli Hansel e Gretel, abbandonati nel bosco, finiscono nella casa di una strega che intende cucinarli. I due riescono non solo a fuggire ma anche ad uccidere la strega. Quest'episodio trasforma la loro vita, che da quel momento in poi i due decidono di dedicare alla lotta alle streghe.

programme.title: The Canyons
programme.desc: Christian è un ventenne ricco, prepotente e manipolatore. La fidanzata Tara è, invece, una ex modella che pur di stare con Christian calpesta propria dignità. Le loro vite saranno cambiate da un incontro sessuale che li condurrà in un percorso di violenza, inganni e paranoia.

Janet si trasferisce da sola in un nuovo appartamento. La ragazza comincia ad essere vittima di allucinazioni e scopre che tra quelle quattro mura aleggia un'inquietante presenza, che la condurrà al suicidio. Lara, la sorella, decide allora di indagare sulla scomparsa della sorella...

programme.title: Grace is Gone
programme.desc: Un padre vedovo porta le figlie in viaggio prima di dir loro la verità

programme.title: Willed to Kill
programme.desc: Una detective della omicidi è costretta a lavorare a fianco del suo ex fidanzato per indagare su un omicidio che porta tutte le caratteristiche di un famigerato serial killer.

programme.title: Ricetta mortale
programme.desc: Ivy e Skyler hanno aperto un popolare sito web. La salute di Ivy risente dello stress. Il suo medico la fa scansionare. Le resta solo poco tempo da vivere. Comincia con farmaci costosi, illegali e sperimentali. Il dottore sta mentendo?

programme.title: La ricetta dell'amore
programme.desc: Courtney è un cuoco che gestisce il ristorante di famiglia. Vive le sue storie in base ad un cimelio lasciatoli in eredità dal padre: un libro intitolato "Le Regole dell'Amore". Quando il bel Jake piomba nella sua vita, lei si trova a scoprire l'amore dove se lo sarebbe meno aspettato.

programme.title: Un amore da ricordare
programme.desc: Dopo un anno di interazioni esclusivamente online, Tenley, un'orticoltrice eco-consapevole, trova finalmente il coraggio di incontrare di persona la sua nuova fiamma, Jared. Quando Jared non si presenta a causa di un incidente in bicicletta, Tenley viene scambiata all'ospedale per sua moglie. Per salvare l'azienda di Jared, sarà costretta a mentire all'intera famiglia di lui ed al suo migliore amico affascinante quanto irritante: Everett.

programme.title: Love on Trend
programme.desc: Quando una blogger di moda riceve un nuovo numero di cellulare, riceve messaggi e inviti destinati alla donna affascinante che possedeva il numero prima di lei. Si immerge così in questa vita più eccitante, innamorandosi persino dell'affascinante ex fidanzato della donna.

programme.title: Elvis & Anabelle
programme.desc: Spinta dalla fanatica madre, Anabelle è il lizza per la vittoria della corona di Miss Texas, quando muore durante il concorso. Finisce così in obitorio, dove lavora Elvis, un imbalsamatore il cui forte amore per il padre malato gli impedisce di coltivare i propri sogni.

programme.title: La radio del cuore
programme.desc: Conduttrice di podcast di successo, Samantha Desouza ha una passione per la musica e un'avversione per il romanticismo dopo la brutta esperienza vissuta di recente.

programme.title: Il diario dell'amore
programme.desc: Henry e Penny vivono a New Orleans e sono una coppia molto affettuosa, fino a quando la tragedia colpisce.

programme.title: Il sesso e Mrs. X (Sex & Mrs. X)
programme.desc: È buffo cosa pochi giorni a Parigi possono insegnare a una donna single da poco sulla vita e sull'amore. Ma la cosa più buffa è che lo imparerà da una donna che dirige un servizio di escort d'alto bordo.

programme.title: L'amore oltre la guerra
programme.desc: Un soldato tedesco cerca di capire se la resistenza olandese è riuscita a far infiltrare una spia nella casa del Kaiser Wilhem in Olanda all'inizio della Seconda guerra mondiale. Durante l'indagine finirà però con l'innamorarsi di una olandese ebrea.

programme.title: Sono affari di famiglia
programme.desc: Vito (Dustin Hoffman) vive con il padre Jessie (Sean Connery) e il figlio Adam (Matthew Broderick). Insieme gestiscono un commercio all'ingrosso di carni.

programme.title: The Imitation game
programme.desc: Ritratto intenso e inquietante di un brillante e complesso uomo, THE IMITATION GAME mostra un genio che, sotto una pressione angosciante, ha contribuito a ridurre la durata della guerra e, quindi, a salvare milioni di vite.

programme.title: La damigella perfetta
programme.desc: Becca è sempre la damigella d'onore, ma al matrimonio di suo cugino lega con Kyle. Che sia l'ultima volta?

programme.title: Il sapore del Natale
programme.desc: Scarlett è un'incredibile chef e comproprietaria di un ristorante di fascia alta. Ma ogni anno i suoi piatti festivi, troppo sofisticati e unici, non si vendono mai: semplicemente non mettono le persone nello spirito natalizio! Quindi quest'anno, la sua migliore amica e comproprietaria le compra un biglietto per una vacanza culinaria in una bellissima villa... dove Scarlett imparerà di nuovo la cucina festiva da zero, magari troverà l'amore in un affascinante chef rivale del suo passato e riconquisterà lo spirito natalizio di cui il suo cibo e la sua vita hanno veramente bisogno.

programme.title: La perla del paradiso
programme.desc: Una fotografa naturalista in cerca di avventure e un timoroso scrittore di romanzi si ritrovano alle Fiji, coinvolti in una caccia ad una rara perla blu.

programme.title: Un Natale quasi perfetto
programme.desc: Una coppia di giovani sposi invita a casa le rispettive famiglie per festeggiare il primo Natale insieme.

programme.title: Lanello perfetto
programme.desc: Proprietaria di una gioielleria, Kate disegna anelli di fidanzamento e fedi nuziali. Quando, un giorno, rivede il suo primo amore Jaimie, questi le offre di lavorare come stilista di gioielli in una grande casa di oreficeria.

programme.title: Party Girl
programme.desc: Angélique ha 60 anni. Ama ancora le feste, le piacciono ancora gli uomini. Di notte, per guadagnarsi da vivere, gli fa bere in un night club nei pressi del confine con la Germania. Con il passare del tempo, i clienti diventano sempre piu' rari. Ma Michel, suo cliente fisso, è ancora innamorato di lei. Un giorno, chiede a Angélique di sposarlo.

programme.title: American Life
programme.desc: La storia di Burt e Verona, una coppia di trentenni che aspetta un bambino. La gravidanza procede bene fino a quando ricevono una notizia improvvisa e sconvolgente: gli eccentrici genitori di Burt annunciano che lasceranno il Colorado per trasferirsi in Europa. A questo punto, viene a cadere l'unica ragione per la quale avevano deciso di stabilirsi lì. Dove e vicino a chi dovranno mettere si casa per crescere il bambino in arrivo? I due ragazzi partono così per un viaggio che li porterà a far visita ad amici e familiari, in città diverse, per valutare tutte le possibili opzioni.

programme.title: Sugar!
programme.desc: Leslie una casalinga e insegnante di pianoforte di oltre 50 anni decide di seguire il sogno della sua vita di essere una cantante rock 'n roll. Purtroppo questa sua decisione viene accolta con grande disappunto da parte del marito che che è in corsa per una carica politica.

programme.title: The Gods
programme.desc: In un moderno Romeo e Giulietta, Mikey James, un imbroglione cresciuto per strada con i suoi due fratelli, va a lavorare per la famiglia Fasano mentre cerca disperatamente di trovare una via d'uscita dal suo stile di vita frenetico.

programme.title: Juliet, Naked
programme.desc: Annie vive una relazione abitudinaria con Duncan, fan ossessivo dell'ormai sconosciuto musicista rock Tucker Crowe. Un incontro con l'elusivo rocker che cambierà la vita di tutti i protagonisti.

programme.title: Sing Street
programme.desc: Un ragazzo cresciuto a Dublino durante gli anni '80 evade dalla sua complicata situazione familiare, formando una band per far colpo sulla ragazza che gli piace.

programme.title: La Finestra di Alice
programme.desc: Gabriele, aspirante scrittore pieno di debiti, passa le giornate a spiare dalla finestra la bella dirimpettaia Alice. Non riuscendo a sostenere le spese per il lussuoso appartamento avuto in eredità, il giovane decide di affittare una stanza allo spagnolo Fabio. La convivenza fra i due si rivela piuttosto complicata perché i ragazzi si scontrano spesso per via di grosse diversità caratteriali, ma poco dopo nel palazzo di Alice avviene un omicidio e Fabio diviene il principale indiziato.

programme.title: American Life
programme.desc: La storia di Burt e Verona, una coppia di trentenni che aspetta un bambino. La gravidanza procede bene fino a quando ricevono una notizia improvvisa e sconvolgente: gli eccentrici genitori di Burt annunciano che lasceranno il Colorado per trasferirsi in Europa. A questo punto, viene a cadere l'unica ragione per la quale avevano deciso di stabilirsi lì. Dove e vicino a chi dovranno mettere si casa per crescere il bambino in arrivo? I due ragazzi partono così per un viaggio che li porterà a far visita ad amici e familiari, in città diverse, per valutare tutte le possibili opzioni.

programme.title: Tutta colpa del vulcano
programme.desc: Per i viaggiatori di tutto il mondo l'eruzione del vulcano Eyjafjallajökull è un duro colpo. Per Alain e Valerie è un disastro. Per poter arrivare nel piccolo villaggio della Grecia per il matrimonio della loro figlia, questa coppia di divorziati, che nutre un odio reciproco senza limiti, sarà costretta a intraprendere il viaggio insieme.

programme.title: Tutte Pazze Per Charlie
programme.desc: A una festa, Chuck, dieci anni, non rispetta la regola del gioco della bottiglia, rifiutandosi di baciare una ragazza. Determinata a non far trovare a Chuck il vero amore, questa, per vendetta, gli getta il malocchio. Vent'anni dopo Chuck è un dentista che non riesce ad avere una relazione stabile.

programme.title: Walk Hard: The Dewey Cox Story
programme.desc: La storia del cantante Dewey Cox che supera ogni avversità per diventare una leggenda musicale. Il film è una parodia delle biografie musicali come 'Ray' e 'Quando l'amore brucia l'anima' - 'Walk the line'.

programme.title: Fiori d'acciaio
programme.desc: Nella fittizia Chinquapin, Louisiana, si sta preparando un matrimonio. La sposa è Shelby (Julia Roberts) la cui madre (Sally Field), farebbe di tutto per lei.

programme.title: Julie & Julia
programme.desc: Una quasi trentenne frustrata da un impiego temporaneo come segretaria si sfida da sola ai fornelli: dovrà preparare tutte le 524 ricette del manuale di cucina di Julia Child in un anno. E racconta le sue tribolazioni in un blog che conquista gli amanti del cibo.

programme.title: Le piacevoli notti di Justine
programme.desc: Nell'Ottocento, due attori girovaghi aprono un locale equivoco, sfidano il governatore

programme.title: Quando le donne si chiamavano Madonne
programme.desc: Tre giovani vanno a Prato, tra amori, un processo per adulterio e conquiste di belle ragazze del posto.

programme.title: Le favolose notti d'Oriente
programme.desc: Due lestofanti raccontano Le Mille e una notte erotiche per soddisfare lo sceicco e salvarsi la vita.

programme.title: Oh dolci baci e languide carezze
programme.desc: Un ingegnere si invaghisce di una hippy, finisce denunciato per droga e accusato di sedurre due minorenni

programme.title: Scusi ma lei le paga le tasse
programme.desc: Un funzionario cade in disgrazia per colpa del nipote, che poi gli soffia la promozione.

programme.title: La donna scimmia
programme.desc: Commedia grottesca di Marco Ferreri con Ugo Tognazzi: Antonio scopre Maria, tutta pelosa, e la porta in tournée come fenomeno da baraccone. Tra scherzi, equivoci e situazioni assurde, il loro strano duo regala risate e sorprese.

programme.title: Il marito
programme.desc: Alberto Sordi interpreta un uomo che, coinvolto in una serie di equivoci e malintesi, si trova a dover affrontare le difficoltà della sua vita matrimoniale. Una commedia che esplora con ironia le dinamiche delle relazioni e del matrimonio.

programme.title: Vita da cani
programme.desc: Le vite di diversi personaggi si intrecciano in un susseguirsi di difficoltà quotidiane e situazioni comiche. Aldo Fabrizi, Gina Lollobrigida e Marcello Mastroianni sono protagonisti di una commedia che racconta le piccole disavventure della vita, con ironia e causticità.

programme.title: Brutti Sporchi e cattivi
programme.desc: Commedia nera e grottesca in una baraccopoli romana: Nino Manfredi è Giacinto, patriarca pugliese che difende il suo denaro tra furti e scherzi familiari. Capolavoro di Ettore Scola, vincitore del premio miglior regia a Cannes.

programme.title: I tartassati
programme.desc: Totò e Aldo Fabrizi, alle prese con le difficoltà quotidiane, affrontano la burocrazia e le complicazioni fiscali con una serie di disavventure comiche e situazioni paradossali, esplorando con ironia le difficoltà della vita moderna.

programme.title: The Dentist
programme.desc: La vita del dr. Feinstone, un dentista di Beverly Hills, sembra apparentemente perfetta, ma in realtà nasconde un terribile segreto. Impazzito dopo il tradimento della moglie, infligge raccapriccianti torture ai suoi ignari pazienti.

programme.title: Fanboys
programme.desc: Un gruppo di fan di Star Wars raggiunge lo Skywalker Ranch per rubare una copia di "The Phantom Menace," così che il loro amico, un malato terminale, possa vederlo prima che esca al cinema.

programme.title: Genitori quasi perfetti
programme.desc: La prossima volta che vuoi organizzare una festa di compleanno a tuo figlio, pensaci!

programme.title: Le avventure di un uomo invisibile
programme.desc: Un semplice pisolino e Nick Halloway, broker un po' esaurito, e' convinto di risvegliarsi come nuovo. Invece si risveglia come... sparito! Volatilizzato. Un incidente nucleare ha trasformato Nick nell'Uomo Invisibile.

programme.title: 3 donne al verde
programme.desc: Tre donne organizzano la rapina più improbabile del Paese: rubare milioni di dollari in banconote destinate ogni giorno al tritadocumenti della banca più sicura degli Stati Uniti d'America. Prendere il denaro sarà facile... ma riusciranno a scappare?

programme.title: La miliardaria
programme.desc: Epifania ha ereditato da suo padre una fortuna favolosa e un consiglio sul tipo di uomo da sposare. Lei, invece, si sposa senza seguire il consiglio di suo padre, ma il matrimonio si rivela un fallimento.

programme.title: Alaska
programme.desc: Un californiano insoddisfatto accoglie con gioia la notizia di un'eredità che lo attende in Alaska. Ma per impadronirsene deve purtroppo affrontare una prova molto dura.

programme.title: Red Dog Linizio
programme.desc: In un villaggio di minatori arriva Red, un simpatico cane randagio dal pelo rosso diventa presto il beniamino del villaggio. Red stravolgerà la vita di tutti ma soprattutto quella di John con la quale instaurerà un rapporto d'amicizia speciale.

programme.title: Io, Dio E Bin Laden
programme.desc: Gary Faulkner, ex detenuto disoccupato, parte per il Pakistan armato solo di una spada acquistata in TV. Convinto che Dio gliel'abbia chiesto, tenta di catturare Osama Bin Laden compiendo undici viaggi in una folle missione solitaria.

programme.title: Ercole contro Roma
programme.desc: Tra rivolte, tradimenti e scontri spettacolari, Ercole affronta Roma per difendere il suo popolo e ristabilire la giustizia.

programme.title: Golia e il cavaliere mascherato
programme.desc: Tra castelli, duelli e congiure, Golia affronta nemici mascherati per difendere il regno e ristabilire la giustizia.

programme.title: Golia alla conquista di Bagdad
programme.desc: Tra intrighi di corte, battaglie e colpi di scena, Golia affronta nemici e tradimenti per salvare Baghdad e difendere il regno. Diretto da Domenico Paolella.

programme.title: Erode il grande
programme.desc: Tra potere, intrighi e tensioni di corte, Erode difende il trono affrontando tradimenti e scelte che segnano il destino del regno

programme.title: Joko invoca Dio... e muori
programme.desc: Un uomo rintraccia i cinque fuorilegge che hanno ucciso suo fratello, mentre viene pedinato da un misterioso detective Pinkerton.

programme.title: Rimase uno solo e fu la morte per tutti!
programme.desc: Un uomo viene accusato ingiustamente di rapina in banca, spingendo il fratello a farlo uscire di prigione.

programme.title: Ombre rosse
programme.desc: Un gruppo di persone che viaggiano su una diligenza trovano il loro viaggio complicato dalla minaccia di Geronimo e imparano qualcosa l'uno dell'altro nel processo.

programme.title: La valle dell'oro
programme.desc: Mason viene accusato dell'omicidio del socio Benson dopo un'imboscata nella miniera. Ma Benson, creduto morto, è vivo e ha un piano per smascherare i veri colpevoli durante il processo che potrebbe condannare Mason.

programme.title: McLintock

programme.desc: Durantel'estate, Jessica stringe amicizia con un bambino grazie a un cucciolo. Anni dopo si rincontreranno e sboccerà l'amore.

programme.title: Ember

programme.desc: Lina e Doon devono salvare Ember, una città al buio, riparando il generatore di luce e lottando contro la corruzione.

programme.desc: Morrison, dopo la perdita del figlio, accolgono Eli, un bambino di sette anni, in affido.

programme.desc: Il film racconta l'ascesa di Walt Disney, dalla sua infanzia alla fondazione della Disney Brothers Studio.

programme.desc: Nolan trova una zebra neonata e la regala alla figlia Channing, che sogna di addestrarla per il Kentucky Open
